name: thorchain_swap
description: Swap BTC into other assets through THORChain, one way. Builds a standard transaction to the THORChain inbound vault with an OP_RETURN memo; signing and broadcasting use Electrum's regular transaction dialog. Quotes (amount and destination address) are fetched from a configurable THORNode gateway (default: gateway.liquify.com) through Electrum's proxy settings, and the vault address is cross-checked with a second, independently run THORNode (default: public-thornode.nativeswap.io), which only receives the vault's public key. Swaps worth $100 or more pay a 0.1% fee to the plugin developer via a THORChain affiliate memo; smaller swaps are free. No other data is sent anywhere.
author: necromortis
